author: Arigenn
body:
Hi again,

Funkystudios has upgraded all of the Avicus emails, to ensure that they become more official, and to provide the community a secure place to send comments or complaints to Avicus authorities. All administrators and developers now have an email, as well as the official team, and our normal Avicus support email.

Funkystudio's contact email - keenan@avicus.net
Arigenn's contact email - ethan@avicus.net
Posighdun's contact email - peter@avicus.net

ALM's contact email - Austin@avicus.net
Javi's contact email - javi@avicus.net

Support email - support@avicus.net
Official email - officials@avicus.net
Sales email - sales@avicus.net

Thanks!
